channel.title: SCyPS highlights
channel.description: Awards, milestones, and talks from the Center for Smart Cyber-Physical Systems at UMass Lowell.

item.title: SUMMIT: A Secure and Resilient Multi-site Smart Grid Testbed for Multidisciplinary Research and Training
item.description: New award: SUMMIT: A Secure and Resilient Multi-site Smart Grid Testbed for Multidisciplinary Research and Training. National Science Foundation, Major Research Instrumentation Track 2 ($2.0M).

item.title: SUMMIT begins
item.description: SUMMIT begins. NSF's $2M Major Research Instrumentation Track 2 award funds a three-site federated smart grid testbed with NYU and West Virginia University, starting October 1, 2026; a postdoctoral search is under way.

item.title: The FUSION benchmarking framework paper appears in JOCN's special issue on benchmarking in optical networks, followed in October by a QoT-aware grooming paper for multi-band SDM networks
item.description: The FUSION benchmarking framework paper appears in JOCN's special issue on benchmarking in optical networks, followed in October by a QoT-aware grooming paper for multi-band SDM networks.

item.title: ARPO-Sensor Fusion starts under the Massachusetts Technology Collaborative's Applied AI Models program ($625K), performed at UMLARC
item.description: ARPO-Sensor Fusion starts under the Massachusetts Technology Collaborative's Applied AI Models program ($625K), performed at UMLARC.

item.title: Planning Federated AI-Ready Cyberinfrastructure for Advanced Microscopy and Imaging: A Teach-Explore-Design Framework for Community-Driven Infrastructure
item.description: New award: Planning Federated AI-Ready Cyberinfrastructure for Advanced Microscopy and Imaging: A Teach-Explore-Design Framework for Community-Driven Infrastructure. National Science Foundation, OAC Category III ($499K).

item.title: Sukesh Aghara's group publishes in Energy Reports on phasing clean, sustainable alternatives into a university campus's central heating, and the Massachusetts nuclear roadmap enters its public discussion series with events in Boston, Worcester, and Lowell

item.title: Massachusetts Advanced Nuclear and Fusion Energy Roadmaps
item.description: New award: Massachusetts Advanced Nuclear and Fusion Energy Roadmaps. Commonwealth of Massachusetts, Healey-Driscoll Administration.

item.title: Gov
item.description: Gov. Maura Healey names Sukesh Aghara to lead the Massachusetts Advanced Nuclear and Fusion Energy Roadmaps, a statewide effort run from UMass Lowell.
